headlines.title: PayPal Announces Executive Leadership Appointments to Advance Three-Year Strategy
headlines.summary: PayPal Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: PYPL) today announced several executive leadership appointments. This follows several months of strategic planning to establish clear strategies across PayPal's core businesses, simplify its operating model and align leadership accountability with the company's long-term priorities.

headlines.title: Brian J. Lee to Join PayPal's Board of Directors
headlines.summary: PayPal Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: PYPL) today announced that Brian J. Lee will join the company's Board of Directors as of November 30, 2026.

headlines.title: Robinhood Markets vs. PayPal: Which Financial Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
headlines.summary: Robinhood's revenue jumped 51.6% last year, but PayPal trades at a far lower multiple, leaving investors to weigh growth against value.

description: PayPal Holdings, Inc. operates a technology platform that enables digital payments for merchants and consumers worldwide. The company operates a two-sided network at scale that connects merchants and consumers that enables its customers to connect, transact, and send and receive payments through online and in person, as well as transfer and withdraw funds using various funding sources, such as bank accounts, PayPal or Venmo account balance, consumer credit and debit products, credit and debit cards, and cryptocurrencies, as well as other stored value products, including gift cards and eligible rewards. It provides payment solutions under the PayPal, PayPal Credit, Braintree, Venmo, Xoom, Hyperwallet, Honey, and Paidy names. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
